title: Magento Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the Magento / Adobe Commerce platform.

MAGENTO_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM FastCGI socket path or host:port endpoint serving Magento PHP workers.

MAGENTO_DB_HOST.description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL/MariaDB server backing Magento.

MAGENTO_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server component fronting Magento (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

MAGENTO_VERSION.description: Target Magento open-source release version or alias (e.g., latest) to install.

MAGENTO_SERVER_NAME.description: Public virtual host domain name configured for the Magento storefront.

MAGENTO_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem root directory where the Magento application tree is deployed.

MAGENTO_DB_PASS.description: Password authenticating the Magento database user.

MAGENTO_DB_DRIVER.description: Database driver backend used by Magento (e.g., mysql, mariadb).

MAGENTO_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or UNIX socket configured on the Magento web server.

MAGENTO_DB_USER.description: Database username granted privileges on the Magento schema.

MAGENTO_DB_NAME.description: Database name provisioned for Magento catalog, order, and customer data.
